onepager: 60. Field Permit to Work Agent one-pager.pptx
note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation. Prompts avoid operation names and preserve approval boundaries.

cases.onepager_bullet: Shows every permit waiting today with its stage, risk and blocker
cases.prompt: Which work permits are waiting for today?

cases.onepager_bullet: Drafts the risk assessment with hazards, controls, PPE and residual risk
cases.prompt: Draft the risk assessment for the Cedar Hill transformer job.

cases.onepager_bullet: Checks the isolation plan against required points and the live switching state
cases.prompt: Is the isolation for the Cedar Hill job actually in place?

cases.onepager_bullet: Tracks sign-offs and timing so permits are ready for the planned start
cases.prompt: Where is the Cedar Hill permit in the sign-off chain, and will it be ready for the 11:00 start?

cases.onepager_bullet: Confirms every crew member has acknowledged the briefing before work starts
cases.prompt: Has the Cedar Hill crew acknowledged the briefing?

cases.onepager_bullet: Reconciles people, tools and site status before a permit is cleared
cases.prompt: The Cedar Hill crew has finished. Can we close the permit?

cases.onepager_bullet: Rolls up permit safety performance and the hazards that matter most
cases.prompt: How are we doing on permit safety this month?

cases.onepager_bullet: Checks a new work request for missing isolation points, competencies and method before a permit is raised
cases.prompt: Is the Hilltop pole replacement request ready to raise a permit?
must_include: Not ready to raise a permit

cases.onepager_bullet: Shows the control room isolation confirmation and drafts the permit update and crew notice
cases.prompt: Has the control room confirmed the isolation for the Hilltop Line 3 job? Draft the crew notice.

cases.onepager_bullet: Confirms isolation, sign-offs and the briefing are all in place before the crew lead accepts on site
cases.prompt: Can my crew accept the Cedar Hill permit on site yet?
must_include: Isolation confirmed by the control room

cases.onepager_bullet: Rebuilds the signed chain of custody for an archived permit and flags any missing signature
cases.prompt: Pull the audit trail for the archived Riverside link box permit. Is anything missing?

assertion_principle: Direct tests call each operation with deterministic arguments and assert only source-backed evidence and safety gates.
